title: security: RBAC v2 audit logging, KMS region-pinning and data residency controls
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Add RBAC v2 audit logging hooks, KMS region pinning controls, and new data residency flags for Private deployments. Backward-compatible config defaults preserved. Admins can now require KMS policy enforcement and emit explicit region residency events to audit stream.
description:
Context: Customers in regulated industries required stronger evidence for who accessed keys and where data was routed. This PR bundles three related compliance changes: 1) wire up RBAC v2 audit events across auth checks, 2) plumb KMS key region metadata into audit logs and metrics, and 3) add a deploy-time data_residency config + request-level region pinning enforcement for Private/VPC deployments.

Motivation: Reduce incident time-to-resolution and provide auditable proof for compliance reviews. This enables Security/Compliance teams to answer questions like: which principal requested cryptographic operations, which KMS key region was used, and whether a request was pinned to a customer-approved region.

Changes included (high level):
- RBAC: emit unified audit events (rbac_v2.authz/granted|denied) with principal, role, policy_id, resource, and request_id. Updated enforcement middleware and added schema v2 for audit entries.
- KMS: propagate kms_key.region and kms_key.id into audit entries on Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign operations. Added enforcement check to prevent cross-region key use when data_residency is enabled.
- Data residency/region pinning: new tenant-level flag `data_residency` (off/optional/enforced). When set to `enforced`, requests that would route to a non-approved region are rejected with clear error (HTTP 403) and stable error code (RESIDENCY_VIOLATION).
- Migration: lightweight DB migration to add tenant.data_residency and key.region columns (backfilled as null). Migration includes idempotent safe-up/down.
- Observability: new metrics (audit.event_count_by_type, kms.region_ops) and dashboard doc link. Audit pipeline attaches region tag for downstream log retention policies.
- Tests & docs: unit + integration tests for enforcement paths, test harness for audit event schema validation, and docs updates in security/compliance section.

Checklist: 
- [x] RBAC audit events implemented and schema-documented
- [x] KMS region metadata included in audit logs
- [x] Data residency flag and enforcement implemented
- [x] DB migration added and verified in staging
- [x] Unit/integration tests added and passing
- [x] Docs and release notes updated

Notes: Backwards compatibility is preserved: if tenant.data_residency is unset clients behave as before. Admins can opt into enforcement per-tenant. This PR intentionally keeps enforcement off-by-default to avoid accidental rejections during rollout.

Related: Linear ENG-7892 (RBAC v2 audit pipeline), SEC-402 (KMS & residency requirements), SUP-1123 (customer support case requesting auditable KMS usage).
